Manages, plans, and administers the Blum Center’s social innovation programs, including the Big Ideas Contest, the Mastercard Foundation Impact Fund, the Civic Innovation Challenge, and other programs as appropriate. Coordinates and engages with campus, researchers, entrepreneurs, non-profit leaders, government officials, and industry to support student success. Develops and participates in extensive outreach to encourage participation.

15% Manages all social impact program operations to envision and build a robust system of competition and post-competition student resources; develops additional student opportunities to enhance an ecosystem that assists students in pursuing their innovations. Conceptualizes, coordinates, and continually improves virtual and in-person opportunities, including information sessions, writing & budgeting workshops, practitioner-in-residence engagements, partnership networking, pitch sessions, and celebration events.
10% Prepares short- and long-range planning for operations and improvements to processes. Identifies, directs, and actively pursues new opportunities to secure sponsorships and funding.

Represents the Center on innovation issues to the campus and broader university community. Responsible for comprehensive and proactive network management. Initiates and manages efforts to engage faculty and professionals to serve as mentors, judges, sponsors and partners, and ensures productive and collaborative relationships. Leads efforts at maintaining relationships with alumni, judges, mentors, and other partners, and provides opportunities for them to participate in Center activities.

Closely collaborates with Blum Center team members to integrate Big Ideas and related innovation programs with Blum Center education and research initiatives to maximize student opportunities and resource sharing. Supports professional development of all Blum Center students interested in social impact, innovation for low-resource settings, and entrepreneurial pursuits.
Ensures administrative operations adhere to the annual budget.

Provides analysis for highly complex projects. Develops, maintains, and continuously refines operational documentation, program toolkits, and implementation guides to support continuity, knowledge transfer, and long-term program sustainability.
Oversees social innovation program websites and social media. Responsible for leveraging Big Ideas’ CoLab facilities in Blum Hall East to support student innovators and Blum Center initiatives.
5% Selects, trains, and manages students serving in administrative and outreach roles.
5% Applies advanced concepts to perform analysis to determine future directions. Participates in periodic strategic reviews of program goals, structure, offerings, and operations
Advanced knowledge of University rules and regulations, processes, protocols, and procedures for supporting students and collaborating with partners outside the University.
Advanced interpersonal skills including verbal and written communication, active listening, critical thinking, persuasiveness, collaboration, and advising skills.

Advanced knowledge of a variety of administrative operational activities such as planning in advance, event management, fundraising processes, risk management planning, website design, and social media.
Advanced knowledge of methodologies to foster innovation.
Advanced skills in short- and long-term strategic planning, analysis, problem-solving, and partnership building.
Advanced knowledge of university, industry, nonprofit, and civil society collaboration strategies.
